4×4 EXPEDITION · TAJIKISTAN

The Classic Pamir Journey

An unhurried journey through the Pamir Highway, Wakhan heritage sites and high-altitude villages.

13 daysDushanbe → Khorog → Wakhan → Murghab → DushanbeFrom $1432 / person*Ask about this journey ↗

THE JOURNEY

See the Pamirs
up close.

An unhurried journey through the Pamir Highway, Wakhan heritage sites and high-altitude villages.

THE ROUTE

Day by day

DAY 01Welcome to Dushanbe+

Meet the city and visit Hissar and Varzob.

DAY 02Qalai Khumb+

Leave the lowlands and follow the Panj.

DAY 03Jizev+

Reach the Bartang Valley and walk to Jizev.

DAY 04Khorog+

Return to the road and continue to Khorog.

DAY 05Ishkashim+

Travel toward the gateway to the Wakhan.

DAY 06Langar+

Explore fortresses, shrines and villages along the Wakhan.

DAY 07High passes+

Cross the plateau toward Murghab.

DAY 08Murghab+

Explore the high Pamir landscapes.

DAY 09Bartang approach+

Travel from Murghab toward the Bartang Valley.

DAY 10Bartang villages+

Visit local communities and petroglyphs.

DAY 11Qalai Khumb+

Follow the Panj west.

DAY 12Dushanbe+

Return to the capital.

DAY 13Departure+

Transfer onward.

Included on the 4×4 journeys

  • 4×4 transport with driver
  • Accommodation along the route
  • Meals and non-alcoholic drinks
  • Local English-speaking guide or interpreter

Usually arranged separately

  • International flights
  • GBAO permit and registration
  • Museum entrance fees
  • Personal expenses and alcohol

These inclusion details are taken from the current 4×4 itineraries; for other trips and all bookings, request the confirmed written itinerary and inclusions.
